verdict.rationale: Termius ships AI command generation, so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never documents an AI-training opt-out or any data-use policy for AI models. The FAQ on hiding the AI widget and the end-to-end encrypted vaults are adjacent controls and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
